data.title: The Marlow Murder Club
data.description: A British cosy mystery comedy-drama series based on Robert Thorogood's novels, where a retired archaeologist and her two unlikely friends investigate brutal murders in the sleepy town of Marlow.

data.title: Spider-Noir
data.description: A live-action series based on the Marvel comic Spider-Man Noir, telling the story of Ben Reilly, an aging private investigator in 1930s New York, forced to grapple with his past as the city's only superhero.

data.title: The Terminal List
data.description: An American action thriller series following Navy SEAL Commander James Reece, who seeks to avenge the murder of his entire platoon and family, uncovering a deep conspiracy.

data.title: Citadel
data.description: An American spy action series where elite agents Mason Kane and Nadia Sinh, after having their memories wiped, must reclaim their lost identities to fight a powerful syndicate manipulating the world.

data.title: Road House
data.description: An action film remake where an ex-UFC fighter takes a job as a bouncer at a rowdy roadhouse in the Florida Keys, only to discover that not everything is as it seems in this tropical paradise.

data.title: The Idea of You
data.description: A romantic comedy-drama film about Solène, a 40-year-old single mother, who begins an unexpected romance with Hayes Campbell, the 24-year-old lead singer of the hottest boy band on the planet.

data.title: Ricky Stanicky - L'amico immaginario
data.description: A comedy film about three childhood friends who invent an imaginary friend, Ricky Stanicky, to get out of trouble. Twenty years later, they still use him as an alibi, until their families demand to meet him, forcing them to hire an actor.

data.title: The Beekeeper
data.description: An action thriller film following a retired government assassin who embarks on a brutal campaign of revenge after his kind-hearted landlady falls victim to a devastating phishing scam.

data.title: Saltburn
data.description: A psychological thriller set in 2006, where a timid Oxford student, Oliver Quick, becomes infatuated with the charming aristocratic Felix Catton and is invited to spend the summer at his eccentric family's estate, Saltburn.

data.title: S4: La Storia Di Bob Lazar
data.description: A documentary exploring Bob Lazar's claims of working at a secret site near Area 51, S4, where he was tasked with reverse-engineering extraterrestrial technology.

data.title: F1 The Movie
data.description: A sports drama film about a Formula One racing driver who returns after a 30-year absence to save his former teammate's underdog team from collapse, starring Brad Pitt.

data.title: The Dink
data.description: An American sports comedy film about a washed-up tennis pro who, after a career-ending injury, reluctantly embraces the sport of pickleball to earn his father's respect.

data.title: The Gorge
data.description: A science fiction romantic action horror film about two elite snipers from different world powers assigned to guard a mysterious gorge, without knowing what lies inside.

data.title: Tetris
data.description: A biographical drama thriller that tells the incredible true story of the origins of the iconic video game Tetris, the legal battles for its rights, and its tumultuous distribution during the Cold War.

data.title: Napoleon
data.description: A spectacular action epic offering a personal look at the origins and swift, ruthless climb to emperor of French military leader Napoleon Bonaparte, viewed through his volatile relationship with Josephine.

data.title: Silo
data.description: A dystopian science fiction series set in a toxic and ruined future, where thousands of people live in a giant underground silo, and an engineer uncovers shocking secrets after a sheriff breaks a cardinal rule.

data.title: Sugar
data.description: A contemporary neo-noir detective series starring Colin Farrell as John Sugar, a charismatic American private investigator in Los Angeles, grappling with a dangerous secret while searching for a missing Hollywood producer's granddaughter.

data.title: Slow Horses
data.description: A British spy thriller series following a dysfunctional team of MI5 agents who have been exiled to Slough House, a dumping ground for disgraced operatives, under the supervision of their obnoxious boss, Jackson Lamb.

data.title: Shrinking
data.description: A comedy-drama series about a grieving therapist, Jimmy, who, after the death of his wife, decides to break ethical boundaries by telling his patients exactly what he thinks, leading to significant changes in their lives and his own.

data.title: The Morning Show
data.description: An American comedy-drama television series that pulls back the curtain on early morning TV, exploring the modern workplace through the lens of a morning news program facing a crisis after allegations of sexual misconduct.

data.title: The Whisper Man
data.description: A psychological crime thriller about a widowed writer and his son, whose new life in a quiet town becomes entangled with the decades-old case of a serial killer known as 'The Whisper Man'.

data.title: The Secret Woman
data.description: A Danish crime thriller about a woman with amnesia who lives a peaceful life on a Norwegian island, until a stranger reveals she is actually a wealthy Danish heiress who vanished three years prior.

data.title: The Sixth Sense
data.description: A child psychologist attempts to help a young boy who claims he can see and communicate with the dead, leading to a shocking discovery for both.

data.title: Twin Stars
data.description: An Italian comedy about a couple from Civitella, Achille and Stella, who face a crisis in their love. After an escape to Rome and a betrayal, Stella gives birth to biracial twins due to heteropaternal superfecundation.

data.title: Facing El Chapo
data.description: A Mexican crime action thriller film inspired by true events, following two federal police officers who unexpectedly capture Joaquín 'El Chapo' Guzmán, one of the world's most dangerous cartel leaders.

data.title: L'amore sta bene su tutto
data.description: An Italian comedy film that intertwines three different love stories, exploring how love, in all its forms, can surprise, heal, and profoundly transform lives, despite past wounds and misunderstandings.

data.title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
data.description: A documentary exploring how the September 11 attacks and their aftermath continued to shape the lives of an entire generation, from those who lost parents to journalists and soldiers involved in the War on Terror.

data.title: Anacondas: Trail of Blood
data.description: A horror film where a genetically created anaconda, after being cut in half and exposed to an experimental serum derived from blood orchids, regenerates into two aggressive giant snakes.

data.title: The Last House
data.description: A science fiction horror film where a family finds themselves inexplicably trapped inside their home during a mysterious and endless rainfall, unable to leave as an unknown threat looms outside.

data.title: Blood Sacrifice
data.description: A Nordic crime thriller series from Sweden following detective Thomas Berg as he investigates a string of mysterious and ritualistic murders targeting police officers in Stockholm.

data.title: The Last of Us
data.description: An American post-apocalyptic drama series based on the video game, set decades after a mass fungal infection collapses society, following Joel and Ellie as they travel across a dangerous United States.

data.title: House of the Dragon
data.description: A prequel television series to Game of Thrones, set 200 years prior, focusing on the Targaryen family and the civil war known as the Dance of the Dragons.

data.title: Hanno Ucciso l'Uomo Ragno - La leggendaria storia degli 883
data.description: An Italian biographical comedy-drama series that recounts the origins and early success of the iconic Italian musical group 883 in Pavia during the 1990s.

data.title: The White Lotus
data.description: An American black comedy-drama anthology series that satirizes wealth and privilege, following the exploits of guests and staff at a fictional luxury resort over a week.

data.title: The New Pope
data.description: A drama series starring Jude Law as Pope Pius XIII and John Malkovich as Pope John Paul III, exploring power struggles and intrigues within the Vatican.

data.title: Yellowstone
data.description: An American neo-Western drama series following the conflicts surrounding the Yellowstone Dutton Ranch, the largest contiguous ranch in the United States, and the Dutton family's internal struggles.

data.title: Domina
data.description: An historical drama series based on the life of Livia Drusilla, wife of the Roman Emperor Augustus, examining the power struggles of Ancient Rome from a female perspective.

data.title: Una notte da leoni 3
data.description: The final installment of the comedy trilogy, where Phil, Stu, and Doug embark on a journey to get Alan the help he needs, but their plans go awry when they are kidnapped by a dangerous criminal seeking Leslie Chow.

data.title: John Wick
data.description: An action thriller film starring Keanu Reeves as a legendary hitman who comes out of retirement to seek revenge against the men who stole his car and killed his dog, a final gift from his deceased wife.

data.title: Mission Impossible - Protocollo Fantasma
data.description: An action film where Ethan Hunt and his team are disavowed after being implicated in a terrorist bombing of the Kremlin, forcing them to go rogue to clear their names and prevent a global nuclear war.
